```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(gapminder)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
gapminder2 <- gapminder %>%
  filter(year == 2007)

ggplot(data = gapminder2, aes(x = pop, y = gdpPercap)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Population Size", y = "GDP Per Capita (in US Dollars)") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10()
```
